title: Application of analytical ultracentrifugation in gravitational sweep mode coupled with turbidity detection for analyzing polydisperse emulsions of aged biodiesel and alkanes

Alternative fuels offer the possibility of reducing greenhouse gas emissions with the help of the existing fleet. As a result, the introduction of new drop-in fuels leads to more complex interactions between the fuel components.
